english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the skill of persuading people to buy products, services, or ideas.

examples.english: Their excellent salesmanship finally persuaded the customer to choose our service.
examples.traditional: 佢靠住出色嘅推銷技巧，終於說服客人揀我哋嘅服務。
